item.title: Dry, cold weather in Seattle for New Year's Eve
item.description: Seattle's dry, chilly stretch will likely continue until late New Year's Day.

item.title: Seattle’s most anticipated new openings in 2026
item.description: From the return of Barnes and Noble to downtown Seattle to Raising Canes in the University District and waterfront upgrades, 2026 is shaping up to be a milestone year for Seattle openings.

item.title: Seattle police seek vehicle in fatal Beacon Hill hit-and-run crash
item.description: Seattle police are searching for a suspect vehicle in a fatal hit-and-run that killed a 38-year-old bicyclist in Beacon Hill early Sunday.

item.title: Police investigate Mercer Island murder-suicide, Issaquah double murder
item.description: Police are investigating after a mother and son were killed in a possible murder-suicide on Mercer Island on Tuesday.

item.title: WA's Highway 2 to reopen, lifting spirits for Skykomish businesses, residents
item.description: After a nearly three-week shutdown of 50 miles of Highway 2, Gov. Bob Ferguson said Tuesday that the west end of the road from Skykomish to Stevens Pass would reopen Sunday.

item.title: Man charged in WA trooper carjacking, I-5 pursuit
item.description: King County prosecutors charged a 24-year-old man accused of stealing a Washington State Patrol car on Christmas Day while high on meth.

item.title: WA man convicted of trapping ex-girlfriend in dog kennel escapes courtroom
item.description: A convicted felon escaped from a Pierce County courtroom this month after he was found guilty of several crimes connected to torturing and tormenting his former girlfriend.

item.title: El Pollo Loco opens first WA location in Kent
item.description: El Pollo Loco has opened its first-ever Washington location in Kent, serving its signature flame-grilled chicken and Mexican-inspired dishes.

item.title: Seattle weather: Cool and cloudy New Year's Eve
item.description: The new year will bring a return to a more normal pattern for us with lowland rain and more mountain snow. Overnight lows won't be as chilly with nights in the 40s.

item.title: Trooper sues Washington State Patrol over AI deepfake video, harassment
item.description: A longtime Washington State Patrol trooper has filed a lawsuit alleging coworkers circulated a deepfake AI video targeting him because he is gay.
